findings.what: The old loop packed lines ending at `start` into the full `body_rows`, but the new code passes `body_rows - 1`, so a backward page can cover one line fewer than before whenever the last row would have fit exactly.
`body_rows - 1` underflows when `body_rows` is 0 (a zero-height pane), which panics in debug builds and wraps to usize::MAX in release; the old loop handled that case and returned 1.
